charcard.commands.genchar.help: Generate a character from a free-text description.
charcard.commands.import.companion_denie: Only an authenticated Keeper can import an AI companion.
charcard.commands.import.help: Import a SillyTavern card: .import <file> [coc7|dnd5e] [pc|companion|world] — pc/companion take the character half (world machinery stripped); world (keeper-only) imports the module: hooks, variables, keeper lore, and the card's character joins the claimable roster (.pc claim).
charcard.commands.import.list:
Importable cards from installed packs (use `.import <ref> pc`):
{refs}
charcard.commands.import.list_empty: No installed pack ships card files. Install one with `--install`, or import your own card as an attachment.
charcard.commands.import.usage: Usage: .import <card file|pack ref> [coc7|dnd5e] [pc|companion|world] — `.import list` shows the refs installed packs ship.
charcard.commands.import.world_denied: Only an authenticated Keeper can import a world card (it installs room hooks and seeds shared variables).
charcard.tools.import.done_companion: Imported "{name}" as an AI companion (id {id}, {system}). Key stats: {stats}. Lore entries added: {lore}.
charcard.tools.import.done_pc: Imported "{name}" as your player character ({system}). Key stats: {stats}. Lore entries added: {lore}.
charcard.tools.import.no_file: Could not read the character card at {path}.
charcard.tools.import.no_fs: No file access is available in this context.
charcard.tools.import.stripped: World machinery was left out of this character import: {hooks} hook script(s), {vars} variable declaration(s), {ejs} template block(s), {secret} keeper-only entr(y/ies). Module content is keeper-imported: `.import <card file> world`.
charcard.tools.preview.no_file: Could not read the character card at {path}.
charcard.tools.preview.no_fs: No file access is available in this context.
charcard.tools.preview.world_line: World machinery: {hooks} hook script(s), {vars} variable declaration(s), {ejs} template block(s) — keeper-imported via `.import <card file> world`.
charcard.tools.world.cast_line: Cast registered ({count}): {names} — players claim with `.pc claim <name>`.
charcard.tools.world.done: Imported “{name}” as world content: {lore} lore entries (keeper trust), {vars} variable declaration(s) seeded, {hooks} hook script(s) installed.
charcard.tools.world.pregen_line: Cast: “{name}” is on the room's pre-generated roster — players take it with `.pc claim {name}` (for an AI-played version use `.import <card file> companion`).
charcard.tools.world.skipped_line: Oversized entries left out: {count} (first: {titles}) — they exceed the per-entry import cap; trim or split them in the card.
charcard.tools.world.brief_line: Module brief seeded from the card's prose — read it with the module_brief tool (keeper-only).
charcard.tools.brief.none: No module brief here — importing a world card with prose seeds one.
charcard.tools.brief.list: Imported briefs: {names}. Ask again with a name.
charcard.tools.brief.header: Module brief — {name} (keeper-only; never paste to players):
charcard.tools.world.specs_line: Typed variables: {count} tracker(s) defined from the native bundle.
charcard.tools.world.system_pinned: Room system pinned to {system} — the module's pack ships it, so the cast and new characters are built on it (name a system on import to override).
